lane: two-view co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998, doi:10.1145/279943.279962); View A potential-field/subsurface, View B surface; disagreement as the discovery signal
shared_tools_to_reuse: scripts/run_h61.py::setup, stage_canary, stage_fit, stage_exchange (label-blind-quadrants-v2 folds, pin checks, feature-store checks)

hypotheses.status: tested in E2, built in E3
hypotheses.summary: strict A-only stratum (rankA>=0.95 & rankB in [0.35,0.65]) isolated as a standalone emission arm and as the built candidate
B-only veto on single_B (artifact clause of the brief)
radiometric-cover gating of the A-only stratum

experiments: E1 canary + independence (the brief's mandated tests)
E2 fit + one whole-segment exchange + nine-arm matched-budget holdout (validates H66-A/B/C)
E3 build the strict A-only candidate with lane-valid constrained placement, gates, reasoning CSV, run card, publish

build.candidate_field: strict A-only post-exchange: (rankA_post - rankB_post) gated to rankA_post >= 0.95 & rankB_post in [0.35, 0.65]
build.placement: lane-valid constrained greedy: every informative prior constrained from the first placement, cap = floor(0.70 x n), budget n discovered by feasibility probes over [16000, 40000], 3 px minimum separation
build.novelty_rule: no emitted cell is a positive pixel of an informative registry raster (declared post hoc in knowledge/39c; unchanged)
build.emission_values: binary {0,1} (metric-optimal at fixed support, pinned in tests/test_metric.py)

verdict_rule: eligible for the selector only if format+lane+uniqueness+not-union+S1 pass AND the candidate arm beats single_B with the paired 95% CI above 0; otherwise negative/research-only (DOWNLOAD yes, SUBMIT no). No slot is spent by this round; promotion is the separate selector step.
